title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales agent as the agentic home for sellers
notes: claim 63: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing says the landing experience changes for every seller, although Microsoft has not established that scope or default. Its mixed licensing model and medium cost also imply a confirmed charging arrangement for the new home when the briefing itself correctly says that arrangement is not published.

claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 Sales agent access control is at Sales agent administrator settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: Under Tenant, select Access settings. ... Select Allow access to Sales agent. ... Dynamics 365: Allows access to the Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent is documented for these Sales agent tenant access settings.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "access settings" "API"; "Sales agent" "access settings" "PowerShell"; "Sales agent" "tenant" "Dataverse Web API" access. Opened access-settings-apps and msdyn_salesagentconfiguration; no equivalent operation identified.

claims.claim: The environment Microsoft Copilot setting is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Chat Agent > Microsoft Copilot > environment > Edit Setting.
claims.quote: go to Copilot > Settings. Under Power Apps, expand Chat Agent and choose Microsoft Copilot. ... Select an environment group or an environment name, then select Edit Setting.

claims.claim: No equivalent API or automation call is documented for this environment Microsoft Copilot control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Copilot" "model-driven apps" "Power Platform API"; "Microsoft Copilot" "model-driven apps" "PowerShell". Opened add-microsoft-365-copilot; searches also returned pac copilot reference material, but no equivalent setting operation.

claims.quote: Open the Sales agent administrator settings. ... Under Features, select Sales Chat. ... Select Add.

claims.quote: Searched: "Sales Chat" "Dataverse" "API" configuration tables; "Sales Chat" "PowerShell". Opened set-up-sales-chat and msdyn_salesagentconfiguration; no table-list operation found.

claims.where: Why it matters: first sentence; rationale: impact
claims.claim: This changes the screen every Dynamics 365 Sales seller opens first.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "home" "landing" dashboard default; "Sales agent" "agentic home". Read roadmap, use-sales-chat and install-sales-app. The record says sellers "can land" in Sales agent, not that every seller's opening screen is replaced.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of Why it matters with "The roadmap describes a home that sellers can land in instead of a traditional dashboard." Replace the impact rationale with "Medium. The planned home is aimed at sellers in Dynamics 365 Sales, rather than the wider workforce; Microsoft has not stated whether it replaces the opening screen for every seller."

claims.claim: The licensing model for this change is mixed.
claims.quote: model: "mixed"; licensing.notes: "Nothing is yet published for this home itself." Open questions: "Will the home need a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, or will Sales Enterprise or Premium be enough?"
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "unknown". Keep the existing licensing notes distinguishing documented general Sales agent licensing from the unpublished licensing for this home.

claims.claim: The new home has a medium cost because general Sales agent premium features need Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: cost: "medium"; licensing.notes: "Nothing is yet published for this home itself." Cost and licensing: "No price, meter or Copilot Credits rate is published for the agentic home itself"
claims.fix: Set cost to "low". Replace the cost rationale with "Low. Known costs are administrator time, seller communication and possible Dataverse search storage growth. Licensing for this home is not yet published." The standard requires rating the known cost of this change, not carrying over a general product add-on requirement.

claims.claim: The new home surfaces meeting context drawn from both CRM and Microsoft 365 data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home"; Dynamics 365 Sales "agentic home" default enable dashboard licensing price actions. Read use-sales-chat, set-up-sales-chat and roadmap. General chat has these data sources, but the home's grounding mechanism is not stated.
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with "Medium. The roadmap plans agent recommendations and customer-meeting preparation in a new landing experience, while its default and dedicated controls are not yet stated."

claims.claim: The checklist's instruction to review Dataverse capacity has a corresponding governance control row.
claims.quote: After rollout: "Review Dataverse capacity if Dataverse search is newly enabled." The controls table covers home selection, application access, environment Copilot enablement and the Sales Chat table list, but not capacity monitoring.
claims.fix: Remove "Review Dataverse capacity if Dataverse search is newly enabled" from the governance checklist; the capacity-monitoring step has no corresponding control row. Keep the documented storage-cost explanation.
